_note: Interpreted bipolar axes for each need's semantic-range matrix in the geology-globe callout (Task 5, 'Divergence Surface'). HAND-INTERPRETED by reading the signals at each pole of the two dominant PCA directions inside each need (run `python build_semantic_range.py --poles "<need>"` to redump the poles). We deliberately trade a little rigor for legibility (design call 2026-07-02): the axes distill each theme's two dominant semantic directions into a simple bipolar pair rather than raw cluster terms. x = PC1, y = PC2; each pair is [negative-pole label, positive-pole label] matching low->high projection. RE-INTERPRET EACH HARVEST: PCA sign/structure shifts as the corpus grows, so re-read the poles and update these labels before rebuilding, then bump _generated_against.
